summary: Implemented Console.set_window_title per the spec, without running tests or repo code and without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union. rich/control.py adds the format entry (OSC 0 with BEL terminator) and the Control.title classmethod, which passes the title as a single two-item tuple. rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal, returning a bool, with the required docstring warnings. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) once per title control. CHANGELOG.md gets an Added heading above Fixed with a bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_control_title, test_set_window_title, test_control_set_window_title (Windows-only via the module's existing skip). Not verified by execution: pytest, black, and mypy were not run.
